description.en: Canadia-inspired flattened elongate annelid with grouped overlapping broad dorsal chaetae, widest/longest near the midline, and two smooth anterior tentacles. Fine chaetal teeth, gills and segment counts simplified, no fine-spike noise coat.
description.zh: Canadia启发扁长环节动物，成组叠覆宽叶状背刚毛靠中线较长较宽，具两根光滑头须。微细锯齿、鳃和体节数量简化，不以细刺噪声覆盖。
